subject: Save-or-sunset: HelioHealth renewal terms request
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lin <sophie@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Save-or-sunset: HelioHealth renewal proposal and options

Sophie — following our call this morning, attached is the latest renewal quote (v3) and a one-page summary of the options we discussed. High level: HelioHealth is coming up on their 12/1 renewal for 480 inference hours/month (production) + 50K embedding units. They signaled they may consolidate spend and consider a competing vendor unless we can reduce cost and guarantee improved SLA for mission-critical endpoints.

Options I proposed on the call (we need internal sign-off to offer these):
- One-time retention credit (applied to final invoice) — $40k–$60k range
- First-year discount applied to hosted API list — 10–20%
- 6–12 month term reset to align billing cycle with their fiscal year
- SLA add-on: bump to 99.95% for the core inference route (with credits)

Attachment: HelioHealth_Renewal_Quote_v3.pdf (PDF, 235 KB)

Next steps: Sophie asked that we escalate any ask >$35k credit or >15% discount to leadership — she is evaluating competing quotes this week and needs a response by Friday COB. Sophie CC'd procurement (procurement@heliohealth.com) for the paperwork timeline.

Thanks — I want to keep this account. Please see the quote and advise what we can commit to.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189
From: Sophie Lin <sophie@heliohealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Save-or-sunset: HelioHealth renewal proposal and options

Alex — thanks for the quick follow. We appreciate the flexibility. Two requests from procurement and product:

1) Budget pressure: our budget for this line item is limited. To keep Redwood as the vendor we would need a minimum of 15% off list + either a one-time credit (>$50k) OR a multi-year guaranteed price cap.
2) Reliability: for the clinical inference route we need an SLA commitment at or above 99.95% — unresolved downtimes last quarter caused visible customer impact.

If Redwood can confirm something in writing by Friday (2026-06-11 COB), we’ll prioritize Redwood and pause the procurement review of the competitor. If not, we’ll have to proceed to a formal RFP.

Sophie
Head of Product Operations, HelioHealth
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T07:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Save-or-sunset: HelioHealth renewal proposal and options — escalation request

LAURA / VIVEK — forwarding Sophie’s reply and procurement ask. Quick summary / recommended concession package for consideration: 

Proposed save package (ask leadership approval):
- 15% first-year discount on hosted token rates (applies to inference and embeddings)
- One-time retention credit: $50,000 applied on next invoice
- Term reset: 12 months from signature (moves renewal to 6/30)
- SLA add-on: 99.95% for clinical inference route for first 12 months (with standard credit table)

Why: HelioHealth is strategic in healthcare vertical — references, proof points, and expansion potential. Losing them would create signal risk for healthcare pipeline.

Attachments: Helio_Redlines.docx (Word, 48 KB) — procurement redline (they want explicit response windows and an indemnity clause change).

Timing: Sophie wants a written confirmation by Friday COB (2026-06-11). They will pause competitor evaluation if we can commit. If leadership can’t approve the credit/discount, I’ll propose a narrower package (lower credit, 12.5% discount, 99.9% SLA) and ask for fast legal turnaround.

Please advise if we have authority to sign this off or whether to escalate to the deal desk / CEO.

— Alex
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Save-or-sunset: HelioHealth renewal proposal and options — escalation request

Thanks for the context, Alex. I reviewed the figures and the HubSpot deal (HH-7823). A few points: 

- Credit size: $50k is a material concession but within play for a strategic healthcare account if we secure a 24-month committed ARR target (we should add a performance clause).
- Discount: 15% is at the high end of standard retention discounts. If Legal/Finance are comfortable, I can approve up to 12.5% without further exec review. Anything >12.5% needs CRO sign-off.
- SLA: I want an engineering confirmation on whether 99.95% is realistic for that route on our hosted stack; Operations should confirm before we commit.

Action items for Alex:
1) Push HelioHealth to commit to a 24-month minimum committed spend number in exchange for the $50k credit. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HH-7823
2) Get a short note from Engineering (cc me) confirming support for 99.95% SLA for the specified endpoints and associated credit schedule.
3) If procurement insists on indemnity changes, loop Legal — Marissa, please review Helio_Redlines.docx and flag anything nonstandard.

I can sign off on a package with up to 12.5% discount + $40k credit + SLA 99.9% today, pending Legal note. For anything beyond that, I’ll need to involve CRO.

— Vivek
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Team — short and decisive: we want to keep HelioHealth. Authorize the following counter to send to Sophie this afternoon: 

Approved counter-offer (final without CRO escalation):
- 15% one-year discount on list rates for Year 1 only
- One-time retention credit: $40,000 (applied to invoice #2)
- Term reset: 12 months from signature (alignment to their fiscal year)
- SLA add-on: 99.9% for clinical inference route for 12 months; 99.95% only if Engineering provides written confirmation by EOD tomorrow and Legal signs the amended SLA language
- Condition: Customer signs the attached Amendment and a 24-month commercial commitment letter (HubSpot DL-7823 must reflect committed ARR target)

Marissa — confirm Legal can accept the redlines requested and prepare an Amendment + DocuSign packet. Alex — send the counter to Sophie and procurement with the attached PDF & DocuSign link; explicitly note that the $40k credit is conditional on the 24-month commitment and countersigned Amendment.

If Sophie pushes for $50k or 99.95% without Engineering/Legal confirmation, we decline and offer the competitor window to rebid. Do not escalate to CEO unless Sophie is willing to sign a 36-month commitment.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
